recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR-core source correction is needed for FHIR-8138; any further repair would be archival/publication-history work rather than a current specification source edit.
issue_request: FHIR-8138 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core profiles issue from the 2015 May DAF ballot reporting duplicate section titles/numbers across multiple DAF pages, with examples such as 5.5.15.2, 5.5.15.2.4, and 5.5.15.2.5.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found for FHIR-8138. The Jira resolution said the duplicate titles would be fixed by reorganizing Implementation Guide publishing so IGs received their own numbering, and the August 2015 Jira comment recorded that the work had been fixed. Git history around the vote/comment window shows that IGs were moved into generated subdirectories and that IG URL/identity rendering was reworked in July-August 2015, including DAF page/link updates.
additional_context: The current FHIR core checkout no longer builds the historical DAF IG. The DAF entry in source/igs.xml is commented out, source/fhir.ini has no active DAF profile entry, and no guides/daf or source/daf tree remains in the current worktree. Current DAF mentions are preserved history, examples, terminology identifiers, validator examples, or test fixtures rather than the old section-numbered DAF IG pages. Community and Confluence searches for FHIR-8138 and DAF duplicate section-title terms found no later conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The requested non-substantive duplicate-section-title correction belonged to historical IG publication numbering, was recorded as fixed, and the affected DAF IG pages are not active current-build source artifacts.
